doc.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Stanley Kay's investment in the bands
summary: Stanley Kay knows the business, invested in commissioning original music and PR.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Yeah. With the performance aspect though we’re really lucky to have Stanley. Like no kidding. We could have a million big bands but he really knows the business part very well and he was willing to invest a lot of his money to get us rolling. I mean we commission all of our own music, all of our music is original to us, both the small group and the big band. And just with our PR person, Virginia Wiggs, and it’s a big expense and he’s invested a lot and he’s like a little angel for us. So we’re lucky for that.
